name: Protagonist's Father
source:
Five times Funopoly World Champion, and wishes the protagonist would take up playing the game more professionally.

He and his wife are extremely rich due to Championship winnings.  However, despite that they living in a bungalow somewhere in America.

During the events of Relentless Protagonist, Abigail, after losing to him, proposes that both he and his wife join The Council Of The Unseen, to which they eagerly agree
